<!-- pr-reviewer: 2a0f90e119dd9abae10b1e8588f66583351454c1 -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

The change meets issue #2453. It moves the slow test to the named release heavy lane. All nine tests and all existing assertions remain. The decision record explains the choice.

Local results after a clean trial merge with upstream/main at 585f7e919bf9aed26f5ab07043c11fd4ab38e7ba:

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main --dry-run`: the plan skips the ignored test and builds its test binary.
- `cargo xtask gate release --only 'app heavy: shoulder_adaptive' --dry-run`: the plan selects the binary with `--release` and `--ignored`.
- `cargo test -j 6 -p camcraft-app --test shoulder_adaptive --no-run`: passed.
- The exact changed test in normal debug execution: 0 passed, 0 failed, 1 ignored, 8 filtered out. Libtest reports the named heavy-lane reason.
- The test list contains all nine tests.
- `cargo clippy -j 6 -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.

The compiler-cache wrapper was disabled for these checks. No GitHub runner was used.

Requested changes: none.

Limits: I did not execute the full heavy fixture in release or repeat the debug timing measurement. I did not run mutations. This PR changes test scheduling only. It changes no production geometry, G-code, collision checks, gouge checks, stock simulation, UI, or goldens.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
